8.4. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.area¶

The module defines functions for creating and enlarging areas.

Functions

connectedComponents(railyard[, pathComponents]) Return a list of connected components in the railyard.
connectedComponentsOfArea(area[, pathComponents]) Return a list of connected components in the considered area.
createArea(subtype, name[, nodes, edges]) Convenience function to create an area.
generateArea(subtype, name, graph, …[, …]) Iteratively enlarge area implicitly defined by the nodes and edges.
